authority: User request 2026-10-12: set the software framework and development framework once, up front, then iterate new requirements; keep design intent enforced across long-horizon tasks.

contract.label: 框架级定调
contract.note: Every domain must reach confirmed / not_applicable / deferred-with-owner-waiver before a contract can be sealed. Elapsed time never confirms these.

preference.label: 普通偏好
preference.note: Mid-task detail choices inside confirmed contract sections. Never user_approved or user acceptance.

routine.label: 常规执行
routine.note: Implementation details, tests, docs, refactors and formatting inside the confirmed contract. Proceed without asking.

upfront_packet.presentation: One packet with recommended default per domain, scope, impact and rollback. Ask only unresolved domains.

production_grade.rule: Production-grade means the applicable evidence gate is green, not that more questions were asked.

efficiency_rules: Ask once, in one packet, before implementation starts.
Never re-ask a confirmed domain; reuse its recorded decision and source ref.
Seed domains from existing project SSOT instead of asking the user.
Unknown or project-specific domains stay unknown; they are not filled with plausible defaults.
Routine work inside the contract never triggers a confirmation.
Amendments are batched per requirement, not per file edit.
Verification runs once per deliverable with an independent check, not repeated self-assertion.
enforcement_boundary: Local files, prompts and optional CLI. Same-permission agents can bypass them; there is no authenticated user channel and no client-native confirmation control.
